editorial:
Imagine living for thousands of years and spending every single day fighting in secret wars to keep the world safe. That is exactly what you get with this group of immortal soldiers who cannot die, no matter how many times they get shot or stabbed. You will quickly get attached to Andy, the leader who is tired of the endless cycle, and Nile, a new immortal who is just trying to figure out why she suddenly woke up after being killed in combat. The vibe is a cool mix of a modern spy thriller and a fantasy story, making you wonder what it would actually feel like to watch history happen in person while hiding your true identity from everyone.

The action scenes are the real highlight here, with fight choreography that feels smooth and punchy. Charlize Theron is a powerhouse as the lead, and the chemistry between the team members feels genuine. While the plot is a bit simple and the villain is a little generic, the pacing keeps you hooked until the end. If you have a high-end TV, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the fight scenes in full detail. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: After a big fight, the team defeats the evil CEO and his mercenaries. They manage to save Nile and keep their secret safe from the public. However, the big twist is that Andy's healing power finally stops working, meaning she is now mortal and can actually die. The movie ends with a cliffhanger when Quynh, a teammate who was trapped in an iron maiden at the bottom of the ocean for centuries, finally finds them and returns for revenge.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves immortal heroes and great fight scenes.
